title: Escape the War Room: 11.11 Meltdown
description: 10 PM, the night before the 11.11 sale. Checkout is down, login is under attack, and the bill has tripled. One shortcut caused all three. Find it with three AWS Frontier Agents before midnight.

learning_recap.title: 🧠 What You Just Learned

cycle.note: AWS DevOps Agent: investigates from the first alarm, maps services, finds the cause, recommends the fix
AWS Security Agent (now part of AWS Continuum): flags risks in code and design, and maps attack paths, before launch
AWS FinOps Agent (Preview): ties each cost to CloudTrail and an owner
You turn every finding into a guardrail and tell the CEO the truth

benefits: DevOps Agent investigates from the first alarm, maps your services and recommends the fix
Security Agent flagged the key three weeks before it leaked
FinOps Agent reports and names the owner; people switch things off
Enterprise Support includes monthly DevOps Agent credits worth 75% of your support charge
